answer.text: The manual's Riding Mode section lists four combinations. The first is Performance + ABS ON.
The second is Performance + Rear ABS OFF.
The third is ECO + ABS ON.
The fourth is ECO + Rear ABS OFF.

watchout_review.reason: Caution concerns the engine malfunction indicator, not riding mode combinations.
Caution concerns the ABS indicator lamp staying on, not which riding mode combinations are listed.
